name: CN_RECALC_REQUESTS_ALL
description: The CN_RECALC_REQUESTS_ALL table holds the recalculation flag update request.

columns.name: CN_RECALC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: This column contains the primary key of the table.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: RECALC_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of object for which the recalculation flag is to be updated. A typical example is User Defined Query used in incentive formula expressions.

columns.name: RECALC_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the name or identifier of the object for which the recalculation flag is to be updated. A typical example is the name of an User Defined Query used in incentive formula expressions.

columns.name: RECALC_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the value of the request for recalculation. Possible values are Y indicating yes and N indicating no.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies the latest request for the specific object code for the given business unit.Possible values are Y indicating yes and N indicating no.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
